nodes.description: Address of the external N contract (InterfaceN) queried by NGame for token traits and ownership.
Carried-over seed value from the previous generation, read and updated by nGameFromSeed.
Mapping tokenId => generated number; written in mint and read in tokenURI.
Mapping tokenId => owner, authoritative ownership state mutated by _mint and _transfer.
Mapping owner => balance, mutated by _mint and _transfer.
Reentrancy guard flag read/written by the nonReentrant modifier.
Public mint guarded by nonReentrant; checks tokenId bounds and external N ownership, writes state then safe-mints.
Private seed engine: performs eight external getter calls and eight random operations, then updates lastGenN.
Private view helper deriving operation choice from block.timestamp, block.difficulty, msg.sender.balance and tokenId; uses unchecked arithmetic.
Internal mint that afterwards verifies receipt via _checkOnERC721Received.
Internal mint updating _balances and _owners and emitting Transfer.
Private function that performs an external onERC721Received call on contract recipients and handles revert data.
Internal transfer clearing approvals and updating balances and owners.
Builds on-chain SVG/JSON metadata from userGeneratedN[tokenId] via Base64.
Hook overridden by NGame/ERC721Enumerable to maintain enumeration on every transfer/mint/burn.
Caller-controlled address used as mint recipient, ownership check and randomness entropy.
Miner-influenced timestamp used as seed input for random().
External calls to InterfaceN(addressN) ownerOf/getFirst..getEight whose results drive seed computation.
Unchecked add/sub/mul/div in random(), including division by a user-influenced operand.
External callback to IERC721Receiver(to).onERC721Received executed inside the mint flow.
Caller-supplied token id bounded by 0<tokenId<8889 and used to index storage.
Local accumulator initialized from lastGenN and repeatedly fed through random().
Local operation selector (0-3) computed from the keccak seed hash.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used in mint for the InterfaceN ownership require and as the _safeMint recipient.
msg.sender.balance is hashed inside random() as an entropy source.
block.timestamp is hashed in random(), making generated values miner-influenceable.
mint invokes nGameFromSeed to derive the token value before minting.
mint writes the computed value into userGeneratedN[tokenId] before _safeMint.
mint reads addressN to build the InterfaceN instance for the ownership check.
mint calls _safeMint after the state write.
nGameFromSeed calls random() eight times with external getter results.
nGameFromSeed consumes return values of the eight external InterfaceN getters.
nGameFromSeed stores the final accumulator back into lastGenN.
External InterfaceN calls execute arbitrary code on addressN and return data into nGameFromSeed.
random() performs unchecked add/sub/mul/div on the seed and external operands.
_safeMint calls _mint to create the token.
_safeMint calls _checkOnERC721Received, which can execute an external receiver callback.
_checkOnERC721Received performs the external onERC721Received call on the recipient.
The recipient callback can re-enter mint while the original call is still in the try block (guard-limited).
_mint writes _owners[tokenId] = to.
_mint increments _balances[to].
_mint invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
_transfer invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
_transfer decrements _balances[from] and increments _balances[to].
tokenURI reads userGeneratedN[tokenId] to build metadata.
The nonReentrant modifier reads and writes _status around mint.
The tokenId parameter flows from mint into storage writes and _safeMint.
The currentGenN local carries the seed through the eight random() calls.
The opNum local drives which unchecked arithmetic branch random() executes.

normalization_plan.reason: tokenId is a mint parameter whose only role is to index the ownership check, userGeneratedN write and _safeMint call, so it normalizes into the mint function node.
currentGenN is a stack local seeded by lastGenN and only used to compute the return value, so it normalizes into nGameFromSeed.
opNum is a local selector computed from the seed hash that directly selects the unchecked arithmetic branch, so it merges into the unchecked arithmetic unsafe operation.
